notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Jegantha's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.
